stories.title: 以技能之桥联通世界 第48届世界技能大赛闭幕

en.title: Building Bridges Through Skills: 48th WorldSkills Competition Closes
en.summary: The 48th WorldSkills Competition concluded in Shanghai with results announced across 64 events. China's delegation topped the medal standings at the competition, which served as a platform for young skilled workers worldwide to compete and demonstrate their abilities.

en.title: 2026 China-Russia International Football Invitational Kicks Off in Shanghai
en.summary: The 2026 China-Russia International Football Invitational began in Shanghai featuring Shanghai Shenhua against Saint Petersburg Zenit. After a 90-minute draw, Zenit defeated Shenhua 4-3 in a penalty shootout.

stories.title: 特朗普称预计本周继续与伊朗谈判

en.title: Trump Says Expected to Continue Negotiations with Iran This Week
en.summary: U.S. President Trump stated in an interview that negotiations with Iran are expected to continue during the current week. This follows Trump's rejection of an Iran-proposed war-ending plan the previous day.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）综合消息：中国队包揽乒乓球女单冠亚军 严子怡首秀破纪录夺冠

en.title: Aichi Nagoya Asian Games: China Sweeps Women's Table Tennis Singles; Yan Ziyi Breaks Record on Debut to Win Javelin Gold
en.summary: At the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games, Wang Manyu defeated Sun Yingsha to win women's table tennis singles gold as China captured both medals and achieved eight consecutive golds in the event. Eighteen-year-old Yan Ziyi broke the Asian Games record with a 70.46-meter throw to win women's javelin gold.

en.title: Gobi's "Mulan" Stands Guard at the Border
en.summary: Inner Mongolia's first professional all-female border patrol unit, established in April 2023, comprises 14 members from multiple ethnic groups responsible for patrolling and managing over 45 kilometers of borderline and related territory.

en.summary: The Czech Republic defeated Ukraine 2-0 in the final of the 2026 Billie Jean King Cup held in Shenzhen on September 27.

en.title: China Retains Top Spot on World Skills Competition Medal Count with Historic Best Performance
en.summary: China ranked first in both gold medals and overall team standings at the 48th World Skills Competition that concluded September 27 in Shanghai, earning 41 golds, 11 silvers, and 4 bronzes.

en.summary: The 33rd China Television Golden Eagle Awards and 16th China Golden Eagle Television Art Festival opened in Changsha on September 27.

en.title: Fourth "Great Wall Covenant" Global Promotion Activity and World Cultural Heritage Dialogue Held in Qian'an, Hebei
en.summary: The fourth Great Wall Covenant global promotion event and world cultural heritage dialogue opened in Qian'an, Tangshan on September 27. Domestic and international experts, scholars, and photographers delivered keynote speeches and held discussions on Great Wall cultural heritage protection and civilizational exchange.

en.summary: At a China sports delegation meeting on September 27, the delegation's secretary-general stated that Chinese athletes' performance in the first half of the 20th Asian Games met pre-competition expectations.

en.title: Chinese Athletes Chen Yuanjiang Wins Gold in Men's 110m Hurdles, Wu Yanni Takes Bronze in Women's 100m Hurdles at Aichi Nagoya Asian Games
en.summary: At the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games track and field finals on September 27, Chinese athlete Chen Yuanjiang won the men's 110 metre hurdles with a time of 13.15 seconds, while Wu Yanni claimed bronze in the women's 100 metre hurdles with 13.12 seconds.

stories.title: Police arrest man, 34, over hidden cameras found in Hong Kong gym changing rooms

en.title: Police arrest man, 34, over hidden cameras found in Hong Kong gym changing rooms
en.summary: Hong Kong police arrested a 34-year-old local man in connection with three suspected pinhole cameras discovered in changing rooms at a 24/7 Fitness branch in Sha Tin. The arrest followed a voyeurism investigation launched at the facility.

en.summary: The article discusses Beijing's strategies to counter U.S. sanctions, set against a backdrop of ongoing geopolitical tensions including statements about Iran and Venezuela made by the U.S. president at the United Nations.

en.title: Buyers snap up new Hong Kong flats ahead of likely interest rate rises
en.summary: Hong Kong developers sold over 290 newly launched residential units over the weekend as purchasers rushed to secure mortgages before anticipated local interest rate increases later this year.

stories.title: Global property investors see signs of recovery in China, but wary of oversupply: JLL

en.title: Global property investors see signs of recovery in China, but wary of oversupply: JLL
en.summary: International property investors are detecting early recovery signals in China's office and retail markets but remain cautious about excessive supply. According to JLL's Asia-Pacific capital markets chief, foreign institutions are expected to resume purchasing once oversupply concerns diminish and new properties are absorbed by market demand.

stories.title: How Asia-Pacific property markets are drawing fresh capital despite US rate uncertainty

en.title: How Asia-Pacific property markets are drawing fresh capital despite US rate uncertainty
en.summary: Asia-Pacific property markets are attracting increased investor interest despite uncertainty following the US Federal Reserve's recent interest rate increase. Cross-border investment volumes in the region have grown by approximately 30 percent, with multiple asset classes and sectors expected to continue drawing capital.

en.title: Hong Kong tycoon-backed start-up bets on new battery to challenge energy-storage giants
en.summary: EnerVenue, backed by Hong Kong tycoon Peter Lee Ka-kit's family office, is manufacturing nickel-hydrogen batteries in China with plans to compete in the growing global energy-storage market.
